stem: True or False: In most cases of conjunctivitis seen in a primary care setting, vision remains normal.
explanation: Visual acuity is generally normal in conjunctivitis unless there is corneal involvement (keratitis) or significant mucus blurring the vision.
rationale: Think about whether the inflammation usually affects the internal structures of the eye or just the surface membrane.

optionExplanations.A: Visual acuity is generally normal in conjunctivitis unless there is corneal involvement (keratitis) or significant mucus blurring the vision.
optionExplanations.B: Reduced vision is actually a warning sign that the condition may be more serious than simple conjunctivitis, as standard conjunctivitis does not affect acuity.

source.hint: Think about whether the inflammation usually affects the internal structures of the eye or just the surface membrane.
